name: Student Visa and Residence Card

requirements.blocker_text: Non-ECOWAS nationals must obtain a biometric long-stay student visa before departure, requiring an official admission letter from a state-recognized institution, proof of accommodation, a return ticket, comprehensive health insurance, a yellow-fever vaccination certificate, and financial proof of EUR 2,000-4,000/year. After arrival, registration with local police within 3 months is required to obtain a Foreigner's Identity Card.
requirements.fix_path: Secure university admission, then apply for the long-stay student visa at a Senegalese consulate before travel.

requirements.blocker_text: ECOWAS citizens do not need an entry visa but must apply for a student residence card once in Senegal if staying beyond 90 days.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the student residence card in-country after enrollment.

evidence_required.document: Health insurance (hospitalization, routine care, medical repatriation)

sources.title: Expat.com (private expatriate-guide site) -- Senegal student visa/residence process for ECOWAS vs non-ECOWAS nationals, required documents, financial proof thresholds, and post-arrival police registration for the Foreigner's Identity Card
